subject.name: Ocean Bottle
subject.selection: Ocean Bottle remains a suitable startup-origin case study: the independent reviewer reports a B Lab listing describing a 2019 founding and a LinkedIn company profile listing 2018. These differing published statements describe a relatively recent venture; neither is resolved into an unqualified founding date. The accessible commercial website supports the SEO case study; current legal startup classification was not independently established.

Thank you for choosing to hear from Ocean Bottle. If you are exploring a reusable bottle, start with the Original Bottle page to review the available features and options. Our FAQs cover delivery, returns and warranty questions so you can decide at your own pace.

You can also read how Ocean Bottle describes its collection model on the impact page. We do not ask you to take an environmental statement on trust: review the explanation before deciding.

Explore the Original Bottle when you are ready.

Ocean Bottle team

email_policy.entry_rule: One active workflow per contact. Higher priority replaces lower; duplicate entry never restarts a clock.
email_policy.suppression: Recheck marketing consent, unsubscribe, withdrawal, hard bounce, complaint and global suppression before every message.
email_policy.cap_rule: Defer capped messages without advancing the step; expire at workflow deadline. Never burst-send overdue messages.
email_policy.inactivity_rule: No tracked click or qualifying event by expiry ends the workflow. Opens are not required or treated as reliable intent.
email_policy.reentry_rule: Completion or inactivity suppresses replay of that workflow in this proposed pilot; later reentry needs a new approved policy.

measurement: Use consent-aware analytics and a documented UTM taxonomy: source, medium, campaign, content, term.
